## ✨ Added

- **The browser extension's video button shows on other sites too,** on a video you are watching, once your instance says yt-dlp can download the page. Its switch is "All other sites" in the video button's settings, with its own defaults for what a click downloads.
- **The video button always downloads with yt-dlp,** also on a site whose links your instance hands to JDownloader, such as archive.org. Links you paste keep their routing.
